prompts.en: Create a single production game texture atlas for a first person Japanese dark fantasy dungeon crawler. Square 2048 by 2048 image, a precise 4 by 4 grid of equal square texture cells, each cell fills its entire area edge to edge. Every cell is an orthographic straight-on closeup of a flat wall surface with equal soft frontal lighting, medium scale readable material details, restrained semirealistic hand-painted shading in two or three tonal layers. Grid order from top left to bottom right: 1 soot-dark basalt masonry with ember cracks; 2 wet grey masonry with copper water pipes and verdigris; 3 pale salt crystal rock with worn timber braces; 4 brown stone covered by thick roots, moss and small fungi; 5 tarnished silver mirrored wall panels with muted purple reflections; 6 charred wooden library shelves packed with aged books; 7 patched timber wall with faded market cloth and brass fittings; 8 dark submerged stone with barnacles and teal sediment; 9 iron machinery wall with brass conduits and riveted ribs; 10 dark blue observatory stone with fine brass star inlays; 11 black layered abyss rock with downward flowing violet mineral veins; 12 weathered ochre canyon rock with chalk boundary markings; 13 giant beast settlement wall made of timber, rope and leather over huge weathered scales; 14 basalt masonry with a glowing brazier niche; 15 root-covered stone with flowering vines; 16 observatory masonry with concentric brass rings. Each cell is an independent material texture, edges of cells align precisely at quarter increments of the image. The entire composition consists of material surfaces and structural details. Texture atlas intended for runtime UV sampling.
prompts.ja: 日本のダークファンタジー迷宮探索ゲーム向け壁面アトラス。正方形を4列4行に区分し、各区画を正面から見た平らな壁面で満たす。柔らかな正面光、控えめな半写実表現、2〜3段階の陰影。左上から行順に、熾火の亀裂がある黒い玄武岩、銅管と緑青のある濡れた石積み、木組みと塩晶、根と苔と菌類、銀鏡の壁面、焦げた書棚、市場の木壁と布、水没した石壁、鉄と真鍮の機械壁、星を象嵌した観測所、紫の鉱脈が下へ流れる深淵、境界の印がある黄土色の岩、巨獣の鱗と木材・縄・革、火床のある壁、花咲く蔦の壁、同心の真鍮環がある壁。実行時の部分参照に使う素材画像。

prompts.en: Create a single game illustration atlas for a Japanese dark fantasy dungeon crawler. Square image, precise 4 by 4 grid of equal square cells. Each cell contains one centered full object, comfortable margin around the entire silhouette, consistent straight-on three-quarter product view and uniform deep charcoal background filling every cell. Restrained semirealistic hand-painted rendering with two or three clear shading layers, muted colors, readable silhouettes at small sizes. Row major order: 1 an iron brazier with amber flame; 2 a copper sluice gate control wheel; 3 a salt-encrusted cracked mine barrier and small pickaxe; 4 a planter with thick living roots and green shoots; 5 a tall oval tarnished silver portal mirror reflecting soft lavender light; 6 an open aged magical book on a wooden lectern; 7 a small trader stall with a brass balance and tied purse; 8 an antique brass air bell with a pocket of pale blue air; 9 an industrial electrical switchboard with copper wires and a small amber lamp; 10 a brass astronomical orrery with blue stone base; 11 a stone compass showing deep violet currents toward a dark center; 12 two weathered prayer boundary stones joined with a faded rope; 13 a miniature timber platform and rope bridge resting on huge beast scales; 14 a branching root bridge; 15 thorny red brambles; 16 a climbing vine with broad leaves and pale flowers. The full illustration fills all sixteen cells with evenly aligned spacing, each object separate within its own cell. Asset atlas intended for runtime cropping in exploration cards.
prompts.ja: 日本のダークファンタジー迷宮探索ゲーム向け装置アトラス。正方形を4列4行に区分し、各区画に物体を1個ずつ中央配置。全体が収まる余白、斜め正面の統一視点、濃い炭色の背景、2〜3段階の陰影と控えめな半写実表現。左上から行順に、篝火、水門の銅製ハンドル、塩の障壁とつるはし、根と新芽の植床、銀の転移鏡、本と書見台、天秤と財布の露店、空気を閉じ込めた真鍮の鐘、配電盤、天球儀、深淵へ向かう紫の流れの羅針盤、縄で結ばれた境界石、巨獣の鱗の上の木製足場と縄橋、根橋、赤い荊、花と葉のある昇降蔦。各物体は区画内に独立して配置し、探索カードで部分表示する。
